youtube_short.title: Wrong Beneficiary Wipes Out $380K
title_alternatives: 42% of Americans Have This IRA Mistake
One Form Destroys Your Retirement Legacy
youtube_short.description: Your beneficiary form legally overrides your will — and 42% of Americans have the wrong person listed. A single outdated form could hand your entire 401k to an ex-spouse, trigger $47,000 in probate fees, and force your heirs into the 37% tax bracket through the SECURE Act's 10-year forced withdrawal rule. That's up to $380,000 gone from a $500,000 account. Log into your retirement account today and update it. Takes five minutes. #personalfinance #retirement #401k #ira #estateplanning #moneymistakes
